wire.headline: Hearth & Home Interiors Announces Closure of 42 Stores Amid Revenue Decline
sentences: Hearth & Home Interiors has announced that it will close 42 stores nationwide.
The company reported an 18% revenue decline in Q3 2026.
CEO Julian Thorne cited shifting consumer habits as the reason for the cuts.
The share price fell 12.4p to 85.2p following the announcement.
The restructuring plan is expected to save 310m GBP annually by 2028.
A total of 4,800 jobs are affected across manufacturing and retail sectors.
The board approved the plan with a unanimous vote on 4 November.
Analysts project a 5.2bn GBP valuation post-restructuring.
